instruction.text: Match the direct speech with the corresponding indirect speech.

atoms.a: “Lizards give me the creeps,” complained Mo.
atoms.b: Mo complained that Lizards give him the creeps.

atoms.a: “don’t make any more noise for the next two hours,” warned Jordan.
atoms.b: Jordan warned not to make any more noise for the next two hours.

atoms.a: “Thank you, Kevin,” said Sergio,“you’re always so helpful.”
atoms.b: Sergio thanked Kevin for always being so helpful.

atoms.a: Paddy asked if we could find somewhere more in the shade.
Kate asked whether anyone had seen her phone.
Jonathan said Stacey’s Mum is an amazing cook.
“Spring,” said Josh, “is my favourite time of the year.”
“Do you know where the cat’s gone?” asked Samantha.
“Does everyone get wrinkles?” the boy asked his father.
